photos.name: both-loaves-cooling
photos.summary: Both finished sourdough boules cooling on the kitchen counter. Foreground loaf on a wire rack with cross score, heavy blistering, and banneton ring pattern from no-linen proofing. Second loaf in background on parchment, flour-dusted with cross score visible.

photos.name: mid-bake-challenger-cross-score
photos.summary: Loaf mid-bake in the Challenger bread pan on parchment paper, lid removed. Cross score opening with good oven spring, flour-dusted crust browning unevenly. Oven interior visible.
